fields.name: priority
fields.description: Higher number will be displayed lower down the list. Set to 0 to hide the effect entirely.

fields.name: is_positive_value_good
fields.description: If true, then positive values shown green in ui. Otherwise shown red and vice versa for negatives. (As sometimes -10% is a good thing like cost)

fields.name: max_value
fields.description: Maximum value of stat, affects stat bars on info panel when calculating percentage full

fields.name: campaign_only
fields.description: Is the stat only relevant to campaign? These are only shown in campaign.

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: Determines order stats shown on info panel

coverage.selection: One exact row per distinct how, chosen by sorted row ID; counterexamples only
